d: As an Account Manager at Talabat, you will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with our restaurant and vendor partners. You will serve as the main point of contact, helping them optimize their presence on our platform, grow their sales, and ensure a high level of partner satisfaction.
Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing restaurant and vendor partners.
Ensure high partner satisfaction and retention through proactive communication, support, and service excellence.
Serve as a trusted advisor, providing partners with insights that support their business growth on the platform.
Analyze sales, operational, and engagement data to identify areas for improvement in menu performance, pricing, promotions, and delivery logistics.
Share actionable recommendations based on performance metrics to drive revenue and efficiency.
Conduct regular business reviews to align on results, opportunities, and growth plans.
Identify growth opportunities within the portfolio – upsell services, suggest cross-promotions, and improve partner performance.
Support partners in optimizing content (e.g., menu structure, images, delivery times) for better customer engagement and conversion.
Recommend and coordinate marketing campaigns and promotional offers to drive order volume.
Collaborate closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Logistics, and Operations to address partner needs and resolve issues promptly.
Ensure smooth onboarding, campaign execution, and issue resolution for assigned accounts.
Negotiate and renew commercial agreements to ensure a fair and strategic partnership.
Ensure partners comply with service-level agreements and maintain operational standards, including delivery quality and availability.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
2-5 years of experience in Account Management, Sales, or Partner Success (experience in food tech, FMCG, or e-commerce is a plus).
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data dashboards and Excel/Google Sheets to analyze performance and generate insights.
*Must be living in or willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi*
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Customer-first mindset with a strong focus on delivering value to partners.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

d: M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Danat Al Emarat is a world-class specialty women’s and children’s hospital in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. It offers advanced medical services across specialties including Neonatology, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, and Women’s Health. The hospital is one of the very few to encompass a dedicated Fetal Medicine Department along with a full-fledged Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) in the UAE. This has established Danat Al Emarat as a regional referral center for women with high-risk pregnancies, supported by its Level III NICU providing care for the most fragile newborns.

The Women's Outpatient Department (Women's OPD) provides comprehensive, patient-centered healthcare services for women across all stages of life. The department focuses on the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and management of various women's health conditions, including gynecological concerns, reproductive health, prenatal and postnatal care, family planning, menopause management, and routine wellness screenings. The Women's OPD is committed to delivering high-quality, compassionate care through a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals, ensuring the physical, emotional, and reproductive well-being of every patient.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We build internal systems to the same standard as our public products: specified, tested, reviewed and observable. We want engineers who enjoy that rigour and take full ownership of what they ship.
q: Treat testing, security, performance and accessibility as part of the job
Handle sensitive people data with care
Write clearly and work well in a distributed team
Own your work from first spec to production
Nice to have: Python, Go, React, Svelte, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, a history of building tools for HR, finance or operations.

The ideal candidate will use their passion for experimentation and analytics to build tomorrow’s tech organisation. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.

As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We focus heavily on the collection of metrics, optimising processes, and ways of working across Canonical. You need to demonstrate leadership, excellence, and consistency and will mentor others in the team.
r: li
Design and deliver systems and platforms, including intuitive UIs
li

li

li

li

li
Write specs, estimate work and deliver to agreed criteria
li
Set a high bar in code review, testing and documentation
li

li

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
